hash_algorithm: sha256 over sorted repository-relative path, NUL, file bytes, NUL

metric_contract.missing_predictions: scored as failures and retained in denominators
metric_contract.zero_denominators: null for ratio values; threshold gates fail; never promoted to 100 percent
metric_contract.multi_intent_alignment: fixed branch ordinal; omitted branches fail parent completeness

normalization_rules.numeric_comparison: numeric value equality after float conversion
normalization_rules.unknown_metric_entity_fields: raise evaluator exception; never silently discard

error_handling_rules.candidate_response_error: retain the case, preserve the runtime error, and score the available or missing prediction
error_handling_rules.infrastructure_timeout: retain runtime_error and attribute earliest failure to INFRASTRUCTURE
error_handling_rules.evaluator_exception: invalidate the evaluation; do not skip or retry a case
error_handling_rules.missing_prediction_field: score as prediction failure; do not skip

serialization_schema.name: farta-v10-final-replacement-raw-results.1.0
serialization_schema.encoding: JSON UTF-8, pretty printed, unescaped Unicode/slashes, preserved zero fractions, exceptions on encode/decode errors

root_cause.framework_behavior: Collection filter callbacks receive value and key
root_cause.repair: typed closure checks only the collection value

validation.red_regression_reproduction: PASS: failed before patch with ArgumentCountError
validation.deterministic_rescoring: PASS: identical metrics from two scores of the same round-tripped development raw results
